scope: local source and test evidence for carrying a signed Sky Package runtime binding from quote acquisition into A2A approval and fail-closed pre-egress checks
implemented: Package quote requests pin the exact currently reviewed Package key, manifest hash, and input/output schema hashes.

A Package quote requires a Provider-signed runtime binding verified against the connected Agent Card snapshot, exact Package/schema hashes, trusted Provider key, signed pricing version, and every required usage meter.
The verified binding is registered by immutable id/digest; delegation drafts persist the reference and include its digest in owner approval and Broker authorization intent hashes.
Migration 0056 adds binding reference columns without rebuilding agent_delegations, so existing SQLite triggers remain intact.

The Cloud Worker re-reads the active binding, current reviewed Package, current owner-connected Agent Card, configured Provider trust key, and quote meter/pricing requirements before discovery and again after live Agent Card discovery at the send authorization gate. Revoked, partial, mismatched, changed, or untrusted bindings fail closed.
The live discovered Agent Card hash now uses the same canonical SHA-256 function as the connected-Agent directory.
